cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said feather the paint, so I've brushed these three fence boards with a feather. That took my whole Saturday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Feather means soften the edge with a brush. You've barely covered three boards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Soft edges, yes. Three boards took eighteen passes each. Please tell me you can see the work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll go over them with a proper brush. It won't take long.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the neighbours you went over my Saturday's work, then. Don't let your quick coat make it sound as though I never spent the day here.

reason: Keep the same three-board scope from opening to final attribution.
